_comment: Space Cadet Pinball's default keys. Flippers on the bottom-corner buttons (BTN 4 / BTN 6), duplicated on the top corners (BTN 1 / BTN 3); plunger on BTN 5, BTN 2 and joystick down; table nudges on the joystick. Esc is the game's own Exit, so Coin + Start quits cleanly and keeps high scores.
